_note_unseen_arch: UNSEEN-ARCHITECTURE PATH (DESIGN Change 2, layer 1). When the live GPU's gfx_id is not in rank.categorical_vocab.gfx_id (a new/untrained arch), the C++ picker (lgbm_pick.cpp) MUST encode the gfx_id cell as rank.gfx_id_unseen_code (-1 == missing -> LightGBM default branch) and score normally, instead of the legacy hard-gate 'if(gfx_code < 0) return {}'. The model is trained with gfx_id masked on rank.gfxid_mask_p of train rows, so the default branch predicts from the physical GPU-numeric features (cu_count, wave_size, lds_size_per_workgroup_kb, l2_cache_total_kb, boost_clock_mhz, vram_bytes). All other categoricals already follow the same unknown->-1->missing rule (see the .so parity encoding). Mirrors the layer-2 pcfg gfx_code .fillna(-1) behavior.
_note_naive_guard: DEPLOYMENT GUARD (GetSolutionsFallback/PredictSolver lazy walk): the ranked walk MUST skip rank.naive_fallback_solvers (ConvDirectNaiveConv*) and select one ONLY when no non-naive applicable solver exists. These are always-applicable universal fallbacks; without the guard the model ranks one #1 on OOD shapes and the first-applicable walk executes it (~4-20x slowdown; log7-confirmed gfx950/gfx942). Matches develop ND TunaNet (ranks naive last). Offline gold-val: naive pick 51.6%->0.09%, coverage 0.51->1.00, geomean on non-naive-best shapes unchanged (1.0136 oracle vs 1.0132 guarded). ConvDepthwiseFwd2D is a real optimized kernel, NOT a fallback -- do NOT demote it.
